alcohol.answer: China Eastern allows drinks up to 24% alcohol without limit, and 5 litres per person of drinks from 24% to 70% in checked baggage; above 70% is prohibited. Alcohol must go in checked baggage, except what you buy in the passenger terminal, which may go on board.

sections.h: 🍷 What China Eastern says about alcohol
sections.p: From the China Eastern General Conditions for Transportation of Passengers and Baggage (July 2026), sections 5.4.4 and 7.2.3.8, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
China Eastern rule
rows: No restriction in carry-on or checked baggage
Containers of at most 5 litres, and 5 litres in total in checked baggage per passenger
Prohibited in carry-on and checked baggage
Check it in; only alcohol bought in the passenger terminal may be carried on board
Retail packaging with a full, clear label; strong sealed outer packaging; China Eastern may ask for a liability waiver
China Eastern follows stricter laws at the departure, transit or destination place
Not permitted in the cabin; only alcohol served by China Eastern

list: Not on the page: the Conditions give no separate rule for duty-free alcohol bought at an overseas airport.

faq: How much alcohol can I take on China Eastern?
Up to 24% alcohol has no limit; 24% to 70% is limited to 5 litres per passenger in checked baggage; above 70% is prohibited.
Can I carry alcohol in the cabin on China Eastern?
Only alcohol bought in the passenger terminal. Other alcohol must be checked.
Can I drink my own alcohol on China Eastern?
No. Passengers may drink only alcohol served on board by China Eastern.
sources: China Eastern — General Conditions for Transportation of Passengers and Baggage (July 2026)
